name: maxGraph adapter prototype
summary: A concrete GraphAdapter boundary over maxGraph. Loading 20 nodes/20 edges, adding nodes and edges, selecting and snapshotting passed. Undo/redo integration is only partial, so this is an implementation spike, not a finished adapter.
gains: A stable engine boundary the application can own
Load, add, select and snapshot work through one interface
Makes an incremental maxGraph migration possible
losses: X6 custom shapes and HTML nodes need a mapping layer
Feature parity still needs the full editor regression suite

spike.scenario: 20 nodes, 20 edges, adapter load/add/select/snapshot, Vite production build, 1400x900 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: The adapter renders the graph and exposes load/addNode/addEdge/select/snapshot. Undo/redo is marked partial: clicking undo did not reduce the cell counts in the test, and redo produced an extra edge. Do not claim undo/redo parity until the UndoManager integration is fixed.
